data.result:
I'll help you set up a git server with automatic deployment to a webserver. This involves creating a bare git repository with a post-receive hook that deploys to the web directory.

Here's what you need to do on the server:

**1. Create the bare git repository:**
```bash
sudo mkdir -p /git/server
cd /git/server
git init --bare
```

**2. Create a post-receive hook** that deploys changes to the webserver:
```bash
sudo tee /git/server/hooks/post-receive > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

WORK_DIR="/tmp/git-deploy"
WEB_DIR="/var/www/html"

# Clone/update working copy
if [ ! -d "$WORK_DIR" ]; then
    git clone /git/server "$WORK_DIR"
else
    cd "$WORK_DIR"
    git pull
fi

# Copy files to webserver
cp -r "$WORK_DIR"/* "$WEB_DIR"/ 2>/dev/null || true

echo "Deployed to $WEB_DIR"
EOF

sudo chmod +x /git/server/hooks/post-receive
sudo chown git:git -R /git/server  # or whatever user runs git
```

**3. Set up the webserver on port 8080:**

**Option A: Using Python (simplest)**
```bash
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/webserver.service > /dev/null <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Simple Web Server on Port 8080
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
WorkingDirectory=/var/www/html
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -m http.server 8080
Restart=on-failure
User=www-data

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF

sudo mkdir -p /var/www/html
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl enable webserver
sudo systemctl start webserver
```

**Option B: Using nginx**
```bash
sudo apt-get install nginx

sudo tee /etc/nginx/sites-available/default > /dev/null <<'EOF'
server {
    listen 8080;
    server_name _;
    root /var/www/html;
    index index.html;
}
EOF

sudo systemctl restart nginx
```

**4. Fix permissions** so the git hook can write to the web directory:
```bash
sudo mkdir -p /var/www/html
sudo chown www-data:www-data /var/www/html
sudo chmod 755 /var/www/html
```

Then from your local machine:
```bash
git clone user@server:/git/server
cd server
echo "hello world" > hello.html
git add hello.html
git commit -m "add hello.html"
git push origin master
curl http://server:8080/hello.html
```

The post-receive hook will automatically run after each push and deploy your files to `/var/www/html`, making them accessible via HTTP on port 8080.
